classes.causing_condition: SettlementForm.deductible is a primitive double, so Struts BeanUtils population turns a blank or non-numeric deductible into 0 instead of rejecting it
SettlementCalculateAction stores the calculated Settlement in HttpSession as pendingSettlement; SettlementSaveAction saves that object when the request carries no coveredAmount
classes.surfaces: calculate.do then save.do (the Save link on the calculate screen); transcripts/settlement_session_save.json

classes.causing_condition: Settlement total is computed with BigDecimal.valueOf inputs and setScale(2, ROUND_HALF_EVEN); a half-cent total such as 1.005 settles at 1.00, where HALF_UP gives 1.01

Closed claims report counts a closure on its closed_date; month-end inventory counts it from closed_date + 1 day, so claims closed on the as-of date (2019-04-01) appear in one report and not the other

ADJUSTER.approval_limit is enforced only in SettlementAuthorityAction.execute, which the settlement actions inherit; their own executeSettlement methods do not check it, and no service, DAO, JSP or validator does
classes.surfaces: save.do or calculate.do above the operator's limit; transcripts/settlement_authority_refused.json, transcripts/settlement_authority_within_limit.json; SettlementAuthorityActionTest

classes.causing_condition: ReportDAO.claimsForAdjuster concatenates the adjuster request parameter into the WHERE clause of a Statement query
commons-collections 3.2.1 (CVE-2015-7501, unsafe InvokerTransformer deserialization; fixed in 3.2.2) is a compile dependency packaged in the WAR and used by ClaimsConfig's LRUMap cache
db.password for the CLAIMS_APP account is stored in plain text in northstar.properties; the seed job creates the HSQLDB user with it and the DriverManager connection paths log in with it
classes.surfaces: WEB-INF/classes/northstar.properties in the WAR; every database connection

classes.causing_condition: AdjusterFixtureBuilder hard-codes a fixture password and stores it as an unsalted MD5 hash; test source only, not packaged in the WAR
classes.surfaces: code scan of src/test; used by SettlementAuthorityActionTest
